greeting: Good evening. The garden is lovely tonight.
Oh, hello. Mind the new shoots.
chatter: The night air smells of leaves and soil.
I like to read the stars from out here.
Every little plant out here has its own story.
A garden is a very patient sort of book.
dislike: That is a little too lively for a quiet garden.
intro: Hello. I am Hazel. I saw the lights of your little garden from far away.
It looked like a good place to read the night sky. May I stay?
stripped: Oh dear. Something from my garden has gone missing.
I was sure there was something lovely here. How odd.

wantAnnounce.garden-supper: A little supper among the leaves would be lovely.
wantAnnounce.garden-seat: Could there be a seat beside the leaves?
wantAnnounce.greet-the-owl: I should like to say hello to the Owl one evening.

garden-supper: Supper under the leaves. How very civilised.
I do like a little seed with my reading.
garden-seat: A seat among the leaves, just right for reading.
The leaves rustle like turning pages.
I shall sit here until the moon comes up.
greet-the-owl: The Owl and I talked about leaves until late.
We read the same stars from different windows, it seems.
I think this garden will be home now.

wants.brief: A little supper among the leaves
